parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to start displaying results from. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of products to display per page. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the source instance to which the product belongs.

- Public instance IDs for each region:

    - China (Shanghai): iotx-oxssharez200.
    - Japan: iotx-oxssharez300.
    - Singapore: iotx-oxssharez400.
    - US (Silicon Valley): iotx-oxssharez500.
    - US (Virginia): iotx-oxssharez600.
    - Germany (Frankfurt): iotx-oxssharez700.

- Steps to view the instance ID of an Enterprise instance:
    
    1. Log on to the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/) and select a region from the drop-down menu in the upper-left corner of the top navigation bar.
    
    2. On the **Overview** page, find the target instance and view the **ID**.

parameters.name: TargetInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the target instance to which the product is distributed. For more information about instance IDs, see the description of the **SourceInstanceId** parameter.

parameters.name: TargetUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the product belongs. Log on to the IoT Platform console, click the profile picture, and navigate to the **Basic Information** page to view the **Account ID**.
